_comment: Pipeline routing config. tool_labels: label -> {tool name, whether to resolve a place from the utterance}. Every other label in labels.json needs a prompt policy in llm_labels. tau_lo: below this (calibrated) confidence the utterance goes to the LLM to clarify instead of firing a tool.

llm_labels.call_llm: answer_question: answer the space/science question concisely and accurately for an astronaut mid-task.
llm_labels.NO_TOOL: chitchat: reply briefly and warmly; no tools are needed.
llm_labels.OOD: out_of_scope: politely say this is out of scope for Nova and offer help with mission, suit, navigation or space questions.

low_confidence_policy: clarify: the request was unclear; ask one short clarifying question and do not guess a tool.
